description:
Their music creates hypnotic, dance-driven grooves with dark, cinematic
textures, bringing together tradition and modern experimentation. Eurovision
finalists, Puuluup invite audiences to discover the unexpected possibilities
of folk music and this unique instrument.
name: Windmills Music Night - Puuluup BLR

performer.description: Puuluup is an Estonian nu-folk duo formed by Ramo Teder and Marko Veisson, blending traditional folk with world music, underground and pop influences. At the heart of their sound is the hiiu kannel, an ancient bowed lyre transformed through effects, looping and unconventional playing techniques.
performer.name: Puuluup

description:
This piano, double bass and drums trio creates atmospheric music rooted in a
quest for simplicity, drawing inspiration from cinema, classical music and
contemporary pop-folk. Each composition evokes a rich palette of images,
colours and emotions, moving between softness, intensity and intimacy.  
  
With Vermeilles, their second album released on Label Bleu, ROUGE reaches a
new milestone, showcasing greater maturity and collective mastery. Their
melodic and colourful compositions blend traditional jazz with contemporary
soundscapes, creating music that is both sophisticated and accessible.
name: Windmills Music Night - ROUGE BLR

performer.description: Founded in 2018 by pianist Madeleine Cazenave, ROUGE quickly established itself as a leading presence in the French new jazz scene.
performer.name: ROUGE
